active_task: Conditional cereal-legume harvest dry-matter regression under simulated horizontal site federation
review_scope: Primary-source comparison of federated agricultural yield or yield-proxy prediction studies that constrain Paper 2 positioning
claim_boundaries: Do not claim that federated crop or yield prediction is novel.
Do not claim numerical superiority across papers whose targets, units, partitions, clients, metrics, or budgets differ.

Do not describe local data retention, encrypted communication, aggregation noise, or simulation as a formal privacy guarantee without the corresponding verified mechanism, threat model, and accounting.
Do not describe the active regression benchmark as best-crop recommendation, independent field validation, or an agronomic utility study.
Keep post-hoc support guards, development exposure, fixed-grid limits, equal-group metrics, and pooled metrics visibly separated.
